posts.headline: Wheelchair transportation built around dignity and clear coordination.
posts.caption: Need accessible transportation for appointments, therapy, dialysis, or discharge travel? Nexus coordinates wheelchair transportation across Maryland, Washington, DC, and Northern Virginia. Learn more or start booking today.
posts.shortCaption: Accessible wheelchair transportation across MD, DC, and Northern VA.
posts.altText: Nexus Medical Transit wheelchair accessible vehicle parked outdoors

posts.headline: Stretcher transportation for planned medical travel.
posts.caption: When a rider cannot travel seated, clear planning matters. Nexus coordinates non-emergency stretcher transportation for discharge, transfers, and scheduled medical travel across the capital region.
posts.shortCaption: Planned stretcher transportation with coordinated pickup and handoff.
posts.altText: Nexus Medical Transit medical transport vehicle

posts.headline: Recurring dialysis transportation needs consistency.
posts.caption: Dialysis transportation is not just a ride. It needs dependable scheduling, rider support, and communication that works week after week. Nexus helps coordinate recurring transportation across Maryland, DC, and Northern Virginia.
posts.shortCaption: Recurring dialysis rides need dependable coordination.
posts.altText: Nexus shuttle used for recurring medical transportation

posts.headline: Hospital discharge transportation should feel organized, not rushed.
posts.caption: Discharge travel works better when the rider, family, and facility are aligned before pickup. Nexus helps coordinate planned hospital discharge transportation across the Washington metropolitan area.
posts.altText: Interior of a Nexus patient transport vehicle

posts.headline: Know what is happening with every ride.
posts.caption: Livecare helps riders, families, and care teams follow transportation progress with a clearer view of the trip journey. If visibility matters, start with Nexus Livecare.
posts.altText: Coverage map representing Nexus Livecare ride visibility

posts.headline: One main number for public ride coordination.
posts.caption: Questions about booking or service types? Start with the main Nexus line at (888) 639-5766. We coordinate accessible transportation across Maryland, Washington, DC, and Northern Virginia.
posts.altText: Nexus accessible vehicle for public ride coordination

posts.headline: Serving riders across Maryland.
posts.caption: Nexus coordinates medical transportation across Maryland communities including hospital discharge, dialysis travel, wheelchair transportation, and scheduled stretcher service.
posts.altText: Coverage map for Nexus Medical Transit service area

posts.headline: Coordinated medical transportation in Washington, DC.

posts.headline: Caregivers need updates without added friction.

posts.headline: Accessibility is not an add-on. It is part of the ride.
